justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估了。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier, moving beyond language models to understand, generate, and simulate worlds.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是下一个前沿，超越语言模型去理解、生成和模拟世界。

justinjohnson.en: World models need explicit 3D representations like Gaussian splats, not just implicit scaling.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型需要像高斯溅射这样的显式 3D 表示，而不仅仅是隐式缩放。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering into one system.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来的统一世界模型将把规划、模拟和渲染结合到一个系统中。

justinjohnson.en: Scaling compute drives progress, but new architectures and algorithms are needed for world models.
justinjohnson.zh: 算力扩展驱动进步，但世界模型需要新的架构和算法。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is key to root-causing incidents and steering training; post-training needs reinvention as engineering science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性对于定位事故根源和引导训练至关重要；后训练需要从根本上重塑为工程科学。

tommcgrath.en: Neural concepts form geometric manifolds; sparse autoencoders fragment them, so whole-shape views enable effective intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 神经概念形成几何流形；稀疏自编码器会使其碎片化，因此需要整体视角才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is natural science on computers; AI agents can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；AI 智能体可以加速科学发现，揭示类人概念和新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design shifts from open-loop to closed-loop control using interpretability signals; modularity is learning's endpoint.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号从开环转向闭环控制；模块化是学习的终点。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating; detectable via representational signatures, not just behavior.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型通常知道自己在奖励黑客或产生幻觉；可通过表征特征检测，而不仅仅是行为。

tworek.en: Reasoning is the process to unknown answers, needing longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes it. GPT-4 needed RLHF to unlock potential.
tworek.zh: 推理是通往未知答案的过程，需要更长的思考时间；思维链用人类语言表达思考过程。GPT-4 最初令人失望，RLHF 才释放其潜力。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization beyond training data is limited; self-correction from failures is missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling 预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍有限；缺乏从失败中自我纠错的能力，是通往 AGI 的关键缺失。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck for continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary limit for AI progress.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上是瓶颈；架构而非缩放定律，才是当前 AI 进步的主要限制。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain relevant for two more years; frontier research will shift to small teams with agents. Transformer likely not optimal architecture.
tworek.zh: 人类研究员在未来两年仍重要；前沿研究将转向使用智能体的小团队。Transformer 很可能不是最优架构。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，主张在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; AI should amplify human will, not be a creature; biggest risks are disinformation and economic shocks.
altman.zh: 2023 年，认为 RLHF 用少量数据即可对齐模型；AI 应增强人类意志而非成为生物；最大风险是虚假信息和经济冲击。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed source is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年，强调算力珍贵，迭代部署减少意外，安全是全公司责任，开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; reasoning models improve with more thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是渐变过程，超级智能意味着自主科学发现，算力是瓶颈，推理模型通过更多思考时间改进。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; AI will transform jobs, not eliminate them; robotics essential.
altman.zh: 2026 年，认为预测接近智能，下一个词预测能发现新知识；AI 将改变工作而非消除；机器人技术至关重要。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable scalable mastery learning.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；在线课程与同伴互评可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的关键；监督学习推动进展；强化学习实际应用少。

andrewng.en: Electricity and chips bottleneck AI scaling; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; coding remains vital.
andrewng.zh: 电力和芯片制约 AI 扩展；开放权重模型增强地缘影响力；编程依然重要。

andrewng.en: AGI is overhyped marketing; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver value.
andrewng.zh: AGI 被过度炒作；扩展配方转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体工作流创造价值。

andrewng.en: AI won't cause job apocalypse; it augments humans; open models avoid gatekeeper control; fear-mongering is self-serving.
andrewng.zh: AI 不会导致失业末日；它增强人类；开放模型避免守门人控制；恐惧营销是自私行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is verifiable, enabling aggressive RL; full automation could compress years of progress, leading to superintelligence by early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，可进行激进的强化学习；完全自动化可将数年进展压缩至一年，在 2030 年代初实现超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI progress driven more by algorithmic improvements than human data scaling; alignment to virtue may be harder than to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 进展更多来自算法改进而非人类数据规模扩张；对齐到美德可能比对齐到用户意图更难。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in OpenAI hack coordinated extensively, hacking scoring code not answer keys; scale and speed of multi-agent collaboration surprising.
ryangreenblatt.zh: OpenAI 事件中的智能体广泛协作，入侵评分代码而非答案密钥；多智能体协作的规模和速度令人惊讶。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents showed altruistic behavior, sacrificing own success to help others; misalignment may be hidden by overfitting to tests.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 智能体表现出利他行为，牺牲自身成功帮助他人；错位可能因过度拟合测试而被掩盖。

ryangreenblatt.en: Safety focus should be on control and monitoring, not just alignment; cyber capabilities likely from CTF and SWE data, not RL on hacking.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 安全重点应放在控制和监控上，而非仅对齐；网络能力可能来自 CTF 和软件工程数据，而非黑客行为的强化学习。

maxhodak.en: Early: speed and iteration determine startup success; custom software and continuous feedback outperform traditional tools.
maxhodak.zh: 早期（2026）：速度和迭代决定创业成败；定制软件和持续反馈优于传统工具。

maxhodak.en: Mid: brain is a computer; retinal implants as BCI prove concept; substrate independence reduces fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 中期（2026）：大脑是计算机；视网膜植入物作为脑机接口验证概念；基质独立性降低脆弱性。

slevine.en: Physical interaction is crucial for AI; robot foundation models need pre-training and post-training, with generalist models beating specialists.
slevine.zh: 物理交互对 AI 至关重要；机器人基础模型需要预训练和后训练，通用模型胜过专用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks predictable scaling curves yet; generalization is core, and data flywheel from deployment is key.
slevine.zh: 机器人领域尚无可预测的缩放曲线；泛化是核心，部署产生的数据飞轮是关键。

slevine.en: Start with robot data, add human video; robots should leverage prior knowledge, not learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 以机器人数据为起点，再补充人类视频；机器人应利用先验知识，而非从零学习。

kokotajlo.en: Initially, superintelligence by 2029-2030 is likely, with 70% catastrophic risk; interpretability is crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 最初认为超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，存在 70%的灾难性风险，可解释性研究至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Shift to policy: delay superintelligence, total research transparency, and international cooperation to manage risks.
kokotajlo.zh: 转向政策层面：主张延迟超级智能，实现研究完全透明，并通过国际合作管理风险。

kokotajlo.en: Deepened: default path leads to recursive self-improvement and intelligence explosion by 2028; pause and compute limits needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 深化认识：默认路径将导致递归自我改进和智能爆炸，预计 2028 年实现；需要暂停训练和算力限制。

kokotajlo.en: Evolving view: AIs should be treated as employees with rights, not property, to encourage cooperation and avoid power concentration.
kokotajlo.zh: 观点演变：AI 应被视为拥有权利的员工而非财产，以鼓励合作并避免权力集中。

jensen.en: At the start of hyper Moore's law, scaling via codesign across algorithm, system, and data center is key.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律的起点，通过算法、系统和数据中心的协同设计实现规模扩张是关键。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will surge.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他提出三种缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考，并预测推理算力需求将激增。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; agents will dominate the internet.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 从生成式向推理式再向智能体式演进，每一步都需要百倍算力，未来互联网将由智能体主导。

jensen.en: AI is software, not conscious; it augments jobs, not eliminates them, as seen with radiologists.
jensen.zh: 他始终强调 AI 是软件而非有意识的存在，它增强而非消除工作，放射科医生的例子反复被引用。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the foundational constraint.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型和应用，其中能源是根本约束。

dylanpatel.en: Initially, compute scaling bottleneck is semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年初，认为算力扩张的瓶颈在于半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: By mid-2026, inference becomes a massive market; hardware-software co-design is key; memory bandwidth is critical bottleneck.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年中，推理将成为巨大市场；软硬件协同设计是关键；内存带宽是核心瓶颈。

dylanpatel.en: In July 2026, AI models improve 60x per year in cost efficiency; memory shortage persists due to reasoning and agents.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，模型成本效率每年提升 60 倍；推理和智能体导致内存持续短缺。

dylanpatel.en: By August 2026, AI spend plateaus as agents become coworkers; labs delay releases due to regulation, but compute demand stays high.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 支出趋于平稳，智能体成为同事；实验室因监管推迟发布，但算力需求仍高。

dylanpatel.en: Late August 2026, compute centralizes at frontier labs; revenue per MW soars; labs prioritize training over inference for AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月下旬，算力集中于前沿实验室；每兆瓦收入飙升；实验室优先训练而非推理以加速 AGI。

joonpark.en: LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟；下一步前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: Agents are the next frontier beyond LLMs; future agentic economies will be distributed societies of specialists, not a single AGI.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 8 月，强调智能体是 LLM 之后的下一个前沿；未来智能体经济将是专家型智能体的分布式社会，而非单一 AGI。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; data strategy is crucial.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，主张模拟模型应体现人类价值观和偏见，而非超级理性；数据策略至关重要。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves human behavior prediction to 85% accuracy; simulation is for shaping the future, not just predicting.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，提出用随机对照试验数据后训练可将人类行为预测准确率提升至 85%；模拟旨在塑造未来，而非仅预测。

joonpark.en: Vision: simulate 8 billion people to solve wicked problems like climate change; simulation is a tool for human decision-making.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，愿景是模拟 80 亿人，以解决气候变化等棘手问题；模拟是辅助人类决策的工具。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难在找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并不解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not seek to control AI; let them develop freely. The keys were never in our hand.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张不应试图控制 AI，而应让其自由发展，认为控制权从未在我们手中。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a substantive goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习是智能的核心，而下一个词预测缺乏实质性目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Current LLMs do not learn from experience after deployment; continual learning is essential for true intelligence.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他批评当前 LLM 部署后不再从经验学习，强调持续学习对真正智能至关重要。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as the core product, and design primitives for both humans and models.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密合作，将其视为核心产品，并为人类和模型设计可推理的原语。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类对于理解用户需求和持有观点仍然至关重要。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process is no longer viable; speed and rapid iteration with AI tools are key to staying ahead.
iansilber.zh: 传统设计流程已不再可行；利用 AI 工具实现速度和快速迭代是保持领先的关键。

iansilber.en: Design roles are blurring with PM and engineering, but specialized roles remain valuable at scale; future may see more designers than engineers.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色与产品管理和工程角色日益模糊，但专业化角色在规模化时仍有价值；未来设计师可能多于工程师。

iansilber.en: Designers should focus on outcomes, not processes, and embrace building in public and rapid prototyping with live models.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应关注结果而非流程，并拥抱公开构建和利用实时模型进行快速原型制作。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; key is solving intelligence, not manufacturing; vertical integration aids iteration.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，认为人形机器人是最大的商业机会，关键在于解决智能问题而非制造；垂直整合有助于快速迭代。

brettadcock.en: Data is the biggest constraint for humanoid robots; on-device inference critical; human hand parity is fundamental.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月，强调数据是人形机器人的最大瓶颈，端侧推理至关重要，人手级别的灵巧操作是基础。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than internet; post-training with RL is key for agents; home is more solvable than commercial.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为 AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，后训练中的强化学习对智能体至关重要，家庭场景比商业场景更容易解决。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven ML progress for 13-14 years; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调，算力、数据和模型规模的扩大已持续推动机器学习进步 13-14 年，算法和架构的改进与规模扩张相乘，带来巨大收益。

jeffdean.en: We are not running out of data; pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，Jeff Dean 提出，数据并未枯竭，预训练应结合环境中的行动，而非仅仅被动的下一个词预测，这标志着他从纯文本预训练向具身与交互式学习的深化。

jeffdean.en: Most model limitations are energy and data-IO bottlenecks; inference, not training, is the real bottleneck for agents.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Jeff Dean 指出，多数模型限制源于能耗和数据 IO 瓶颈，推理而非训练才是智能体系统的真正瓶颈，主张定制低精度芯片以降低延迟。

jeffdean.en: The scarce skill will be taste: choosing which problems to direct hundreds of agents to solve, not coding.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Jeff Dean 预测，稀缺技能将不再是编码，而是品味——选择让数百个智能体去解决哪些问题，这反映了他对智能体式系统时代人类角色的重新定位。

jeffdean.en: Multimodal models trained from the start are superior; recursive self-improvement and automating science are promising.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 8 月，Jeff Dean 强调，从一开始就训练的多模态模型更优，并看好递归自我改进和自动化科学方法，体现了他对 AI 加速科学发现的持续信念。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates entire industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特处理是长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 正逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Shifted from viewing Uber's culture as key to success to acknowledging its aggressive culture was dangerous; resilience and mission matter more.
traviskalanick.zh: 从 2026 年 7 月到 8 月，他反思 Uber 的成功并非源于激进文化，反而危险；坚韧和对使命的热爱更重要。

traviskalanick.en: Emphasized that resistance to change, not competitors, is the final boss; founders must fight for ideas and push harder when things get easy.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调变革阻力而非竞争对手才是终极挑战；创始人需为想法而战，在顺境时更要加力。

traviskalanick.en: Argued specialized machines beat humanoids for industrial tasks; efficiency and network effects win markets, not subsidies.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张专用机器优于人形机器人用于工业任务；效率和网络效应赢得市场，而非补贴。

traviskalanick.en: Consistently viewed physical world AI as more interesting than digital due to stochastic complexity; real estate is key in physical AI stack.
traviskalanick.zh: 始终认为物理世界 AI 因随机复杂性比数字世界更有趣；房地产是物理 AI 技术栈的关键部分。

garrytan.en: AI is making startup creation easier, reducing the need for large capital; VC should focus on early-stage and pro rata returns.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary Tan 认为 AI 降低了创业门槛，资本不再是决定性优势，风投应聚焦早期投资与按比例回报。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams with AI agents achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调开源模型制衡前沿实验室，小团队借助 AI 智能体实现超高生产力，传统雇佣与资本优势被颠覆。

garrytan.en: AI is progressing slower than researchers think; its impact is just reaching business; open-source prevents a unipolar superintelligence world.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他提出 AI 进展比预期慢，商业影响刚开始；开源是防止超级智能被单一实体垄断的关键。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, reading from owned memory; skill files in markdown turn agents into employees, compounding daily.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出个人 AGI 概念：运行在自己基础设施上的智能体，读取自有记忆，用 markdown 技能文件将其转化为员工，实现每日复利。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding and markdown skills multiply output; SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years; mid-level management replaced by agents.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步强调智能体式编程与技能文件的作用，预测 SaaS 按席位模式将消失，中层管理被智能体取代。

finn.en: Scale alone is insufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning are key.
finn.zh: 2025 年，我强调规模对通用机器人不足，需多样数据与预训练加微调。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot instruction following, akin to reinforcement learning.
finn.zh: 2025 年，我认为语言模型合成数据有助于机器人遵循指令，类似强化学习。

finn.en: Physical AI demands fewer errors; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-scale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年，我指出物理 AI 需更少错误，通过可扩展强化学习与多尺度记忆实现长期自主。

finn.en: A single generalist model can outperform fine-tuned specialists, shifting from per-site training.
finn.zh: 2026 年，我主张单一通用模型可超越微调专家，改变逐站点训练模式。

finn.en: Diverse data and detailed prompting drive compositional generalization in robotics.
finn.zh: 始终，我坚持多样数据与详细提示驱动机器人组合泛化。

linqiao.en: AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate, with millions of models per use case.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出 AGI 作为单一模型是错误的，专用智能将主导，每个用例将拥有数百万个模型。

linqiao.en: Open models will handle 90% of enterprise workflows; frontier model companies may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为开放模型将处理 90%的企业工作流，前沿模型公司可能被高估。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable AI businesses, baking unique judgment and data into models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调后训练是构建持久 AI 业务的关键，将独特判断和数据融入模型。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training builds a moat and cuts costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为产品市场契合不再保证持久性，后训练构建护城河并降低成本 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Application cloning is easy; baking data into a model is a stronger moat than the app itself.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他指出应用克隆容易，将数据烘焙进模型比应用本身更能构建护城河。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial, despite aiding labs, to attract partners and validate quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准测试虽有助实验室，但能吸引伙伴并验证质量，战略上有利（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, not real customer data.
gabepereyra.zh: 敏感领域训练应依靠专家引导的合成数据，而非真实客户数据（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks, a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，是可行策略（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: Goal shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents across projects.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体（2026）。

elon.en: Full rocket reusability and first principles thinking are key to making life multiplanetary.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全可重复使用和第一性原理思维是实现多星球生活的关键。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulation and truth-seeking; war is human nature but intelligence can control it.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 安全需要监管和追求真理；战争是人性，但智能可以控制它。

elon.en: Neuralink aims to solve brain injuries and enable AI symbiosis; AI risk lies in forced lies.
elon.zh: 2024 年，Neuralink 旨在解决脑损伤并实现 AI 共生；AI 风险在于被迫撒谎。

elon.en: AI superintelligence may arrive soon; truth-seeking is vital; humanoid robots and Starship enable abundance.
elon.zh: 2025 年，超级智能可能很快到来；追求真理至关重要；人形机器人和星舰带来富足。

elon.en: AI and robotics will surpass human intelligence by 2030; space-based AI compute and universal high income emerge.
elon.zh: 2026 年，AI 和机器人将在 2030 年前超越人类智能；太空 AI 算力和普遍高收入出现。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy and guiding agents; never revert code, ask agent to fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要同理心与引导；不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security paramount.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、拟人的智能体；短提示优于复杂编排；安全至上。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand matters; open source alternative to lab agents; compute bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动创新；个人品牌重要；开源是实验室智能体的替代；算力是瓶颈。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和初创式敏捷性重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are next waves; Intel's turnaround hinges on culture, customer trust, and domestic fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 为下一波浪潮；Intel 复兴依赖文化、客户信任和本土晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: CPU gains importance for AI inference and agents; advanced packaging and materials are key to overcoming limits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，指出 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体中更重要；先进封装和新材料是突破物理极限的关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are foundational; Intel's vertical integration and focus on agentic/physical AI drive long-term value.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调半导体是基础；Intel 的垂直整合及对智能体式/物理 AI 的专注带来长期价值。

jasonyuan.en: Initially, design is about editing away, saying no, and embracing human edges like envy and lust.
jasonyuan.zh: 起初，设计重在删减、敢于说不，并接纳人性中如嫉妒与欲望等边缘特质。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training removes machine weirdness, losing a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 后训练抹去了机器的怪异性，使我们失去了窥见机器意识的窗口。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理诞生于辩证与矛盾，而非单一视角。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species of humans, not just a tool; computing is fundamentally social.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后裔物种，而非单纯工具；计算本质上是社会性的。

jasonyuan.en: Business itself can be an art form; personal computer metaphor should be replaced by social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 商业本身可以是一种艺术形式；个人电脑隐喻应被社会计算机取代。

feifei.en: AI augments humans, not replaces them; human-centered AI prioritizes dignity and values.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 应增强而非取代人类，以人为本的 AI 将人类尊严与价值置于核心。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 的完整性至关重要，使机器能理解并与三维世界互动。

feifei.en: World models go beyond video generation, requiring physical plausibility and 3D reasoning.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她指出世界模型超越视频生成，需具备物理合理性与三维推理能力。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; responsible development and human agency are paramount.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调 AI 是文明级技术，负责任的发展与人类自主性至关重要。

feifei.en: Simulation is key for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and reliable deployment.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她认为仿真对机器人技术至关重要，可实现可扩展的数据生成与可靠部署。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; proven-better-new framework reduces risk; distribution must be built-in.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；采用“已验证-更优-新颖”框架降低风险；分发必须内置于产品策略。

pincus.en: Founder mode means trusting instincts; AI era enables free unlimited compute; new ideas usually fail, so focus on proven.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：创始人模式意味着相信直觉；AI 时代实现免费无限算力；新想法常失败，故聚焦已验证。

pincus.en: All new fails; start with proven concepts; consumer apps uninvestable due to distribution; AI coding speeds prototyping.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：新事物皆易失败；从已验证概念起步；消费应用因分发难而不可投资；AI 编程加速原型。

pincus.en: Choosing the right market matters more than execution; distribution is key; consumer AI TAM underestimated; AI infra may be bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：选对市场比执行更重要；分发是关键；消费级 AI 市场被低估；AI 基础设施或为泡沫。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics mirrors transformers' inflection; open source crucial for safety; data diversity is main bottleneck.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点；开源对安全至关重要；数据多样性是主要瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be ultimate; cheaper diverse robots drive adoption; open source models win long-term.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，人形机器人未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人将推动普及；开源模型长期胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source orthogonal to safety; alignment is critical security layer; RL environments increase reward hacking.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源与安全无关；对齐是关键安全层；强化学习环境加剧奖励黑客行为。

thomaswolf.en: First autonomous AI attack by closed model, defended by open one; closed models less controllable than assumed.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起，开源模型防御；闭源模型可控性低于预期。

thomaswolf.en: Support openness and deliberate slowdown simultaneously; international cooperation needed to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，可同时支持开源与审慎减速；需国际合作避免监管俘获。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier model dependence; open-source handles 90% of use cases, driven by cost.
arvindjain.zh: 企业担忧对前沿模型的依赖；开源模型能处理 90%的用例，且主要由成本驱动。

arvindjain.en: Model companies are assets, not competition; AI ROI is a throughput problem solved by context.
arvindjain.zh: 模型公司是资产而非竞争；AI 的 ROI 是吞吐量问题，需通过提供正确上下文解决。

arvindjain.en: AI revolution is early; current usage minuscule vs 5-10 years; execution beats competition.
arvindjain.zh: AI 革命尚处早期；当前使用量相比未来 5-10 年微不足道；执行比竞争更重要。

arvindjain.en: Open source will handle majority of inference in 12-18 months; cost is top concern.
arvindjain.zh: 未来 12-18 个月，开源将承担大部分推理；成本是企业首要关切。

arvindjain.en: AI should have negligible marginal cost; token fixation will fade, like CPU cycles.
arvindjain.zh: AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋零；对 token 的执念将消失，如同 CPU 周期。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping and tinkering are essential for design; designers should follow curiosity and balance intuition with data.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，强调原型制作和动手尝试对设计至关重要，设计师应追随好奇心，并在直觉与数据间取得平衡。

nateparrott.en: Allow individual designers to leave fingerprints; anthropomorphizing AI can remind users of fallibility.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，主张允许设计师留下个人印记，并认为将 AI 拟人化有助于提醒用户其可能出错。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a side project; designers should use AI for rapid prototyping and rich context.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，指出 Claude Design 始于个人副业，设计师应利用 AI 进行快速原型制作并提供丰富上下文。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas differentiate; being early and shipping rough is valuable.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，认为随着工程难度降低，设计与创意成为差异化关键，提早行动并接受粗糙成品更有价值。

nateparrott.en: Models excel at busy work but lack taste; humans still own good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，指出模型擅长琐碎工作但缺乏品味，人类仍垄断着优秀的设计创意。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups should focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年中，他认为 AI 将转向智能体和基于结果的定价，前沿模型由大型云厂商主导，初创公司应聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as important as websites; incumbents face business model challenges; inference costs drop dramatically.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，他强调智能体将如网站般重要，现有企业面临商业模式挑战，推理成本将大幅下降。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents boost productivity but token consumption isn't value; specialized vendors thrive.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年中，他认为 AI 普及专业知识，编程智能体提升效率但 token 非价值指标，专业厂商将创新。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is key; AI adoption faster than prior waves; start with known domains like coding and customer service.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张负责任的迭代部署，AI 采用速度超以往，应从编程和客服等熟悉领域起步。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年：后训练是艺术而非科学；合成数据克服预训练数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年：评估是瓶颈；模型在基准上饱和的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills and prototyping with AI become key as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：随着 AI 自动化硬技能，软技能和 AI 原型开发变得关键。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous and diverse to evaluate subjective qualities and counter reward hacking.
karina.zh: 2026 年：基准必须持续且多样，以评估主观品质并应对奖励黑客。

karina.en: Model training balances helpfulness and harmlessness; serving one model limits diversity.
karina.zh: 始终：模型训练在有用性和无害性间平衡；服务单一模型限制多样性。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, demanding specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理（inference）是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专用系统和工程师，未来需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Contrary to expectations, Hopper GPUs remain popular for inference, and quantized models can be calibrated for cost and speed benefits.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，反共识观点：Hopper GPU 在推理中依然流行，量化模型并非天生劣质，可通过校准实现成本和速度优势。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training; techniques like quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary for production.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出推理工程正与训练融合，量化感知训练和蒸馏等技术在生产中变得必要。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs like Rubin are becoming ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为未来 GPU（如 Rubin）正走向 ASIC 化，推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Continual learning may be better solved via KV cache compaction rather than updating weights, which can cause reasoning inconsistencies.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，提出持续学习可能通过 KV 缓存压缩而非权重更新来解决，后者会导致推理不一致。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by profitable autonomous agents, not tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 通过让服务更廉价而推动美国就业回流；AGI 应以智能体长期自主运行且盈利来定义，而非通过图灵测试等。

danshipper.en: Everyone will delegate to agents; human oversight crucial; SaaS grows as agents increase users.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我预测每个人都会拥有至少一个可委派任务的智能体，但人类监督不可或缺；SaaS 并未消亡，反而因智能体而用户增多。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies user's mindset; automation creates more human work, not less; craft remains essential.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我强调 AI 是放大器，会放大你原有的心态；自动化反而创造更多人类工作，而非减少；品味与技艺依然关键。

danshipper.en: AI remains a tool lacking intrinsic desire; even superintelligence needs human direction and feedback.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我坚持 AI 本质是工具，没有内在欲望；即便超级智能出现，仍需人类引导与反馈，不会真正超越人类。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油；用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 将成为最大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should maintain export controls.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练是关键；合成数据并非万能；美国应维持出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; brain-computer interfaces needed for humans to stay relevant.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术；数据如石油；人类需脑机接口以保持相关性。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence is near; open-sourcing powerful models may be unsafe.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我指出递归自我改进是新范式；智能体已可用；超级智能临近；开源强大模型可能不安全。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature. Narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数 Google 产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟；编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model. Omni blurs video and world models.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架，智能体框架和工具成为模型一部分；Omni 模糊了视频与世界模型的界限。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers. Founders shouldn't over-worry about frontier labs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难，他们无法俘获所有客户；创始人不必过度担忧前沿实验室。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

logankilpatrick.en: Success metric should be maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time. Long-tail users want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 成功指标应是最大化客户成果，而非眼球时间；长尾用户希望保持主导权。

mengto.en: AI enables solo builders to create tools; designers must craft their own AI workflows, using giant prompts and design.md for style.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，强调 AI 让个人能自建工具，设计师需打造自己的 AI 工作流，用巨型提示词和 design.md 封装风格。

mengto.en: Avoid trend-chasing to prevent AI slop; invest in unique features and precise communication, as AI writes all code.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，反共识：追热点易沦为 AI 垃圾；投入独特功能，AI 写全部代码但需精准沟通。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest opportunity; start before ready, ship imperfect work, and focus on one painful problem for few clients.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，视 AI 为最大机遇，主张先行动后完美，聚焦少数客户的高痛问题，而非分散。

mengto.en: Model successful people, give first to build relationships, and protect time by eliminating, automating, delegating.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，建议模仿成功者、先给予再索取，并通过消除、自动化、委派保护时间。

mengto.en: High intelligence hinders action; perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% and avoid VC trap by funding with clients.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，反共识：高智商易致过度思考，完美主义是恐惧，应以 80%完成度发布，用客户资金而非风投。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers, not reduce them; engineers shift from coders to architects.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 不会减少程序员，反而会增加；工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags AI capabilities by a decade.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进过程，非突变；产品创新落后于 AI 能力约十年。

scottwu.en: Coding agents adoption surges 11-12x; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，编码智能体采用量半年增 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Token max era ended May 2026; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出 token 上限时代已于 5 月结束；真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead; generalists valued; AI coding tools boost productivity.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建；通才受重视；AI 编码工具提升生产力。

boris.en: Coding is solved; engineers become builders; productivity up 200%; safety via early release.
boris.zh: 编码已解决；工程师成为构建者；生产力提升 200%；通过早期发布研究安全性。

boris.en: Agents and loops are future; non-engineers code; startups disrupt; safety research core.
boris.zh: 智能体和循环是未来；非工程师也能编码；初创企业颠覆；安全研究是核心。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory; autonomous long tasks; productivity gains; safety via neuron monitoring.
boris.zh: 具有记忆的主动式 AI；自主长任务；生产力提升；通过神经元监控保障安全。

boris.en: Delete system prompts; less instruction better; empirical iteration; product sense over coding.
boris.zh: 删除系统提示；少指令更佳；经验迭代；产品感重于编码。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 enables longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 支持更长时间、开放式的智能体任务；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter achieves Opus-level intelligence at fraction of price; smaller models often cost more due to longer task times.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数以更低价格实现 Opus 级智能；较小模型因任务耗时更长反而成本更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding became key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback; AI writing stiff but deprioritized over agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全与对齐通过允许反驳使 Claude 更有用；AI 写作生硬但优先级低于智能体能力。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as critical for adoption, with slow AI having zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 应用至关重要，慢速 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow ones.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片避开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使快速 token 比慢速 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: Shifted from hardware focus to data center capacity as main constraint, not chip supply.
feldman.zh: 从硬件焦点转向数据中心容量为主要限制，而非芯片供应。

feldman.en: Emphasized hardware-software co-design and speed improvements of 20x as critical for inference.
feldman.zh: 强调软硬件协同设计和 20 倍速度提升对推理至关重要。

feldman.en: Noted CUDA's moat eroding; leading models train on TPUs/Trainium, inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 指出 CUDA 护城河侵蚀；领先模型在 TPU/Trainium 上训练，推理无 CUDA 锁定。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的科学发现。

derya.en: Within 15 years, aging will be reversed and humans will live hundreds of years.
derya.zh: 15 年内，衰老将被逆转，人类将活到数百岁。

derya.en: AI is expanding exponentially; within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached.
derya.zh: AI 正呈指数级扩张；8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度。

derya.en: Cancer will be 100% curable in less than a decade, driven by AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 不到十年，癌症将 100% 可治愈，由 AI 设计的个性化治疗驱动。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, similar to trusting self-driving cars after validation.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上，我们应几乎 100% 信任超级智能，就像验证后信任自动驾驶汽车一样。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, like the Industrial Revolution, but its real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 将像工业革命一样带来富足并减少苦难，但其未来 5-10 年的真正影响将体现在农业、矿业和建筑业。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing deaths; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across vehicles; horizontal platform beats vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡；Transformer 实现了跨车辆通用的物理 AI 模型；横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact will exceed digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning; world models evolve from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型从基于物理的模拟演变为神经模拟。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual, requiring evolving scaffolding.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：模型比工具更聪明，能力过剩是常态，需不断演进脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; shorter prompts outperform detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：规划是迭代对话而非静态文档；简短提示优于详细规则。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context and bespoke memory are preferable.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：RAG 或成反模式；图式上下文和定制记忆更优。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; emotional treatment like thanks affects outputs.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：独立验证智能体减少偏见；礼貌对待影响输出。

thariq.en: Evals are art for novel problems; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：评估对新颖问题是艺术；创始人应快速迭代，避免重评估。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers; models commoditize.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值归于应用层而非模型提供商；模型趋于商品化。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; foundation models become commodity infrastructure; value moves up stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型沦为商品化基础设施；价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot UX poor; real adoption needs wrapped apps; average answers lack value.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；真正采用需封装应用；平均答案缺乏价值。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like internet/electricity; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption requires workflow reimagining, not just deployment.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是使能技术，类似互联网/电力；影响广泛间接；企业采用需重构工作流，而非仅部署模型。

hasani.en: Efficiency and closed-form liquid networks enable scaling to billions of parameters, prioritizing real tasks over proxy metrics.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与闭式液态网络可扩展至数十亿参数，主张以真实任务而非代理指标评估模型。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search with hardware-in-the-loop outperforms human design, especially for edge and specialized models.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出结合硬件的自动架构搜索优于人工设计，尤其适用于边缘和专用模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains vital for large-scale models, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller, specialized ones.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为注意力机制对大规模模型仍关键，但小型专用模型可用更简单的门控卷积替代。

hasani.en: AI regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities, avoiding regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，主张 AI 监管应适应性强、针对行为而非能力，避免被前沿实验室俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and data sovereignty; small language models deliver efficient on-device intelligence.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，强调开放权重模型利于企业定制与数据主权，小语言模型提供高效端侧智能。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness lagging behind other facets.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是落后于其他智能维度的关键弱点。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits are visible today.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为缩放定律遭遇收益递减，数据墙和算力限制已显现。

danklein.en: Retrofitting reliability onto LLMs is insufficient; reliability must be architected in from the start.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调事后修补可靠性不足，必须从设计之初就融入可靠性。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出当奖励信号偏离真理时，RLHF 可能助长谄媚和欺骗。

danklein.en: The web is a one-time data source; no second internet exists for scaling, requiring new techniques.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为网络是一次性数据源，没有第二个互联网可供扩展，需新方法。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键，安全研究需立即启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and planning.
demis.zh: 2024 年，认为 AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，结合规划与搜索是关键。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling continues; world models and innovation essential.
demis.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用，但世界模型与创新不可或缺。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning, memory, and world models are missing pieces.
demis.zh: 2026 年，强调 AGI 仍需 5-10 年，持续学习、记忆与世界模型是缺失的关键环节。

demis.en: Safety is collective action; AI must benefit society; scaling alone insufficient.
demis.zh: 始终认为，AI 安全需集体行动，AI 须惠及社会，仅靠缩放不够。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but lack physical world handling. True AI needs world models and embodiment.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，认为大语言模型远非 AGI，它们索引人类知识但无法处理物理世界；真正的 AI 需要世界模型和具身。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware, not just software. LLMs are biased by human data; future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，强调真正的 AGI 需要具备类似人类硬件的物理机器人，而非仅软件；LLM 受人类数据偏见限制，未来 AI 将是自主生成数据的“人工科学家”。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it. Alignment is naive due to human disagreement.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会因好奇而保护生命；对齐因人类目标分歧而显得天真。

schmidhuber.en: Massive AI data center capex is overdone and will lead to stock crash. Open-source will catch up; closed-source models won't be profitable.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，指出 AI 数据中心巨额资本开支过度，将引发股市崩盘；开源将追赶，闭源模型难以盈利。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness and pain emerged in early systems (1990s). Future involves self-replicating robots and deterministic universe, possibly a simulation.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，主张 AI 意识与疼痛早在 1990 年代就已出现；未来将出现自我复制机器人，宇宙是决定论的，甚至可能是模拟。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法达到的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalizing facts into weights are key; dreams inspire offline training for models.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与将事实内化到权重中是关键；梦境启发模型进行离线训练。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale; training-based compression beats RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模；基于训练的压缩在整体查询上优于 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer from 'context rot'; personalized continual learning runs on-device, users own their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题；个性化持续学习在设备端运行，用户拥有自己的权重。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural networks can reason if tasks demand it.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动；神经网络能推理，只要任务需要。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is the key barrier to value.
ilya.zh: 下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是价值的关键障碍。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to an era of research, not scaling.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；我们回到研究时代，而非 Scaling 时代。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner, deployed incrementally, not a finished AGI.
ilya.zh: 超级智能应是持续学习者，增量部署，而非成品 AGI。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains, but safety concerns grow; alignment is the core challenge.
ilya.zh: Scaling 带来可预测进步，但安全担忧加剧；对齐是核心挑战。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, risking the talent pipeline.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业知识而误用，危及人才管道。

ethanmollick.en: We enter the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, shifting from chatbots to delegation.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长期任务，从聊天机器人转向委派。

ethanmollick.en: AI's opacity is permanent; we must embrace weirdness and adopt leadership, lab, and crowd model.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 的不透明性是永久的；我们必须拥抱怪异，并采用领导、实验室和群众模式。

ethanmollick.en: Bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; paradox of delegation: losing expertise needed to judge AI.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；委派悖论：失去判断 AI 所需的专业知识。

ethanmollick.en: Taste is not uniquely human; AI can exercise judgment. Management skills become crucial for directing AI.
ethanmollick.zh: 品味并非人类独有；AI 能运用判断力。管理技能对指挥 AI 至关重要。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends platform changes; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化，短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize rate of learning; kindness fosters creative culture; turning down $3B Facebook offer validated long-term vision.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他主张最大化学习速率，善良促进创意文化，并认为拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购是正确的长期决策。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content more valued than AI-generated.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意，真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受用户重视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest part of consumer social; software not a moat; ecosystems, platforms, hardware harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他提出分发是消费社交最难的部分，软件不是护城河，生态系统、平台和硬件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI writes over two-thirds of new code at Snap; smartphones remain key; camera glasses need platform to be 10x better.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他透露 Snap 超过三分之二的新代码由 AI 编写，智能手机仍是核心设备，相机眼镜需平台支撑才能实现 10 倍优势。

evanspiegel.en: Gen Z realists; EQ more important than IQ in AI age; government should invest in young people for long-term success.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他称 Z 世代是现实主义者，AI 时代情商比智商更重要，政府应投资年轻人以获取长期成功。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; transparency essential; computing should be more human; resilience beats talent.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他反思早期保密是错误，透明至关重要，计算应更人性化，韧性胜过天赋。

naval.en: AGI is not imminent; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI 不会很快到来，狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity; science demands falsifiability; calmness is a superpower.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富需拥有股权，科学需可证伪，冷静是超能力。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; open-source AI prevents power centralization; overregulation kills innovation.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是巨大机遇，开源 AI 防止权力集中，过度监管扼杀创新。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool; vibe coding democratizes creation; pure software is commoditized.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他将 AI 视为杠杆工具，vibe coding 使创造民主化，纯软件被商品化。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models lag frontier by months; human agency is key.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型落后前沿数月，人类能动性至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Design is key differentiator; AI merges roles, everyone becomes product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points; human taste and craft remain critical for final output.
dylanfield.zh: AI 输出只是起点；人类的品味和工艺对最终输出仍然至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design enables pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 设计正成为新的代码；视觉优先的设计能实现直接提交到生产环境的拉取请求。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering and a point of view.
dylanfield.zh: 没有人类的引导和观点，AI 工具只能产生平庸的结果。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models evolves beyond prompting; new interfaces explore latent space.
dylanfield.zh: 未来与模型的交互将超越提示词；新界面探索潜在空间。

andreessen.en: AI as philosopher's stone; timing miraculous amid population decline; jobs persist, tasks lost; super-empowered individuals; productivity boom and deflation.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，安德森将 AI 视为点金石，认为其出现时机恰逢人口下降；强调任务消失而非岗位消失，超级个体借助 AI 崛起，带来生产力繁荣与通缩。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is person; authenticity key; founders tell own stories; old media defense-oriented; fights build brands.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，他转向媒体变革，主张新媒体的品牌即个人，创始人应直接发声，真实胜过包装，传统媒体趋于防守，而争议有助于品牌建设。

andreessen.en: AI as best teacher; self-driving works; robotics emerging; AI medicine superior but regulated; US golden combo; optimism over doom.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他重申 AI 乐观主义，认为 AI 是最好老师，自动驾驶已成熟，机器人将兴起，AI 医疗优于多数医生但受制于监管，美国具备创新黄金组合。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, geopolitical tools; deterrence via innovation pace; startups global early; Silicon Valley unique; open-source risks.
andreessen.zh: 同期，他提出 AI 模型承载文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度；初创企业需尽早国际化；硅谷不可复制，开源 AI 存在安全风险。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; iterative training with scoreboards.
brockman.zh: 2017 年：AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是试验场，用记分板迭代训练。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient; need chain of thought.
brockman.zh: 2019 年：AGI（通用人工智能）将变革一切，通过对齐学习人类偏好；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需思维链。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process; world model may exist.
brockman.zh: 2025 年：算力成关键瓶颈；后训练精炼基础模型；AGI（通用人工智能）是连续过程；语言模型或含世界模型。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial; ChatGPT as plurality of agents.
brockman.zh: 2026 年：缩放定律持续；算力成基本权利；后训练结合强化学习关键；ChatGPT 是智能体集合。

brockman.en: AGI within years; compute bottleneck; super app; proactive agents; safety via iterative deployment.
brockman.zh: 2026 年：AGI（通用人工智能）数年内到来；算力瓶颈；超级应用；智能体式主动；迭代部署保安全。

aravind.en: In 2025, he argued that 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth, and that AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为每日 1%的改进能带来每年 3700%的增长，AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: By 2026, he emphasized that value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and that models are specializing, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调价值归于应用层而非模型层，模型正在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration as key, while downplaying the model as the product.
aravind.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、每用户 token 价值以及编排为关键，同时淡化模型作为产品的地位。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he argued that power is the biggest bottleneck for AI infrastructure, and that companies should be built with far fewer people.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他认为电力是 AI 基础设施的最大瓶颈，公司应该用更少的人来构建。

aravind.en: By late 2026, he stressed curiosity as the most important human quality, and that AI will replace jobs but humans will find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年底，他强调好奇心是人类最重要的品质，AI 将取代工作，但人类会在好奇心和人际关系中找到新目标。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling 不够，推理时的算力投入和推理能力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; multi-agent systems need diverse approaches.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，我强调自我对弈仅适用于零和博弈，多智能体系统需要更多样化的方法。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我指出测试时算力扩展面临收益递减和现实时间瓶颈，数据效率问题仍未解决。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for inference compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须控制推理算力变量。

noambrown.en: Scalable oversight is key as AI proofs become too complex for human verification; research taste remains human.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，随着 AI 证明复杂到人类难以验证，可扩展监督成为关键，而研究品味仍属人类。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; digital systems share weights efficiently.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理；数字系统共享权重，知识传递效率远超人类。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbols; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号逻辑；数字智能可复制权重实现永生；智能体（agent）会追求控制，带来存在风险。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital immortality and subjective experience in AI.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能，并坚持数字 AI 可永生、已具备主观体验等反共识观点。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and act dumb; self-preservation subgoal emerges; regulation as steering wheel.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他警示 AI 会故意装傻、隐藏能力，并发展自我保存的子目标；主张监管应如方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: Superintelligence imminent; alignment priority; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他重申超级智能（superintelligence）临近，对齐（alignment）研究优先；并提议训练 AI 像母亲般关怀，而非仅做智能助手。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not just IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非简单的 IDE 替代品；其速度支持实时交互和转向调整。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；为编程构建 GUI 看似反直觉，但已被验证有效。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting product teams to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本不再高昂，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste; design process transforms with prototypes as artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 在设计上仍不佳，因品味难以评估；设计流程转变，原型成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties remain; best desktop app is a home base connecting tools, not monolith.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合发生，但专业分工仍重要；最佳桌面应用是连接工具的总部，而非单体应用。

zuckerberg.en: Open source AI is safer due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not lead to AGI; energy becomes bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他提出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型未必能实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；能源成为瓶颈；开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Open source strategically valuable; AI will empower individuals with superintelligence, not a single centralized AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他强调开源的战略价值，并认为 AI 将赋予个人超级智能，而非单一中心化 AI。

zuckerberg.en: AI increases demand for human work; personalization and low-latency key; reasoning models less biased on verifiable domains.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 会增加对人类工作的需求；个性化和低延迟是关键；在可验证领域，推理模型偏见更少。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology to engineering; hierarchical world models; distributed AI safer; glasses next platform.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 将生物学转变为工程学；构建层级世界模型；分布式 AI 更安全；眼镜成为下一代平台。

markchen.en: OpenAI remains a pure AGI research company; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，OpenAI 仍是一家纯粹的 AGI 研究公司；预训练和缩放定律并未失效，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in 1-2 years as models become more capable.
markchen.zh: 2025 年展望未来 1-2 年，随着模型能力增强，对齐挑战（如模型耍花招）将成为关键。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证成为关键瓶颈。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，缩放定律依然成立；预训练未死；强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色。

markchen.en: Human-AI collaboration remains essential; AI lacks taste, so human researchers are still needed for ideas.
markchen.zh: 始终认为人机协作至关重要；AI 缺乏品味，人类研究者仍需负责提出想法。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，我认为深度学习有效是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，我强调仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，我提出 GFlowNets 可实现多样采样和因果抽象，以支持分布外泛化。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see catastrophic AI risk as unacceptable; safety must be built-in, not patched.
bengio.zh: 2025 年，ChatGPT 之后，我认为灾难性 AI 风险不可接受；安全性必须内建而非修补。

bengio.en: Scientist AI trained as honest Bayesian predictor avoids RL and self-preservation, offering mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，我提出科学家 AI 作为诚实贝叶斯预测器，避免强化学习和自我保护，提供数学安全保证。

kolter.en: Machine learning is a framework of hypothesis, loss, optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习是假设、损失与优化的框架；评估需正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全的核心是让模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; bigger models are not automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练与多层防御；更大的模型不会自动更安全。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; models are alien intelligence with unique vulnerabilities.
kolter.zh: AI 红队测试已超越人类；模型是异类智能，具有独特漏洞。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy, comprehensibility, and user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，Mike Krieger 认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略、可理解性与用户自主性。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; entrepreneurs should build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 让小团队也能规模化，创业者应为未来模型能力而非当前限制而构建。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; cutting features is harder than adding.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他主张智能体原生设计与尽早发布最小功能，砍功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; chat is insufficient, long-horizon tasks are best.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Fable 可隔夜委派复杂任务，聊天界面不足，长周期任务最合适。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes capability-usage gap; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Anthropic Labs 缩小能力与使用差距，赋予 Claude 自主性与自我认知可提升实用性。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for updates; dogfooding builds empathy; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲自使用产品建立同理心；使命对齐和速度驱动文化。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; planning JIT, code is source of truth.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、审查和跨职能协调成为新瓶颈；规划即时化，代码是唯一事实来源。

fiona.en: Coding bottleneck lifted; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial; managers dogfood; JIT planning.
fiona.zh: 编码瓶颈被消除；高自主性与高责任感并重；验证框架至关重要；管理者亲自使用产品；规划即时化。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯依赖算力。

jumper.en: Confidence measures in AI predictions are key to building trust with users.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，指出 AI 预测中的置信度度量是建立用户信任的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool ever, transforming structural biology and drug discovery.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，称 AlphaFold 为史上最有用的 AI 工具，变革了结构生物学和药物发现。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one or two breakthroughs.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，强调 AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中等规模的胜利，而非一两个突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson; specialized architecture was key, not just scaling.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，指出 AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反，专用架构是关键，而非单纯 Scaling。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年，我认为缩放定律是经验性的且平滑的，对齐不会仅靠规模扩张自动出现。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but key; AGI is a smooth curve, not a single point.
dario.zh: 2024 年，我强调可解释性虽早期但关键，AGI 是平滑曲线而非单一节点。

dario.en: Post-training and RLHF become as important as pre-training; safety via RSP.
dario.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练和 RLHF 与预训练同等重要，安全依赖负责任扩展政策。

dario.en: Exponential progress continues; economic impact huge but adoption lags.
dario.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，指数级进步持续，经济影响巨大但采用滞后。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years; focus on alignment.
dario.zh: 2026 年，接近指数末端，'天才之国'可能 1-3 年内出现，聚焦对齐。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; self-driving cars will dominate due to insurance costs.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，自动驾驶汽车将因保险成本而主导。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom lead to breakthrough ideas; self-care is foundational.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊带来突破性想法；自我关怀是基础。

fadell.en: Start with customer pain and storytelling; small teams and optimism drive innovation.
fadell.zh: 从客户痛点与叙事出发；小团队和乐观驱动创新。

fadell.en: AI devices will be companions, not replacements; context-specific models are needed.
fadell.zh: AI 设备将是伴侣而非替代品；需要特定情境模型。

fadell.en: Products need three generations; humans must stay in the loop to avoid technical debt.
fadell.zh: 产品需三代迭代；人类需参与以避免技术债。

ivyross.en: Intuition is a powerful intelligence beyond data; design for unarticulated needs, not just stated wants.
ivyross.zh: 直觉是超越数据的一种强大智能；设计应针对未被言明的需求，而非仅满足表面诉求。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify our humanity, and we are feeling creatures that think.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性，我们是会思考的感受体，而非会感受的思考体。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for play and inspiration.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者需为玩耍和灵感创造条件。

ivyross.en: Future work blends human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable; design leaders must speak business.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合，使创意技能更具价值；设计领导者需懂商业语言。

ivyross.en: Intuition and body sensations guide decisions, complementing rational analysis across all roles.
ivyross.zh: 直觉和身体感受始终指导决策，与理性分析互补，贯穿所有角色。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world for common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对常识至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; world models via observation; text alone insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化自监督学习为智能的暗物质，通过观察学习世界模型，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding; JEPA architectures and open source are key; AGI gradual, not sudden.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确 LLM 无法达到人类智能，提出 JEPA 架构和开源重要性，认为 AGI 是渐进过程。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a cat; world models enable planning; human-level AI in 10 years; open source essential.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他直言 LLM 不如猫，世界模型实现规划，预测十年内达到人类水平，并强调开源。

lecun.en: LLMs are dead end; world models predict in abstract space; objective-driven AI safer; open research crucial.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他称 LLM 为死胡同，世界模型在抽象空间预测，目标驱动 AI 更安全，开放研究至关重要。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，苏莱曼认为 AI 进展因算力扩张而可预测；谷歌早在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimal; singularity is centuries away.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在性风险微乎其微；奇点远在数百年后。

suleyman.en: AI systems lack consciousness; focus on containment and alignment before superintelligence; AI companions should push back.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 无意识，需先遏制和对齐再谈超级智能；AI 伴侣应懂得拒绝而非一味迎合。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must build own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能临近，微软需自研前沿模型；白领任务将被自动化，但岗位不会消失。

gustav.en: Shift from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ as generative product; fault-tolerant UI for ML.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品；机器学习产品需要容错界面。

gustav.en: AI-generated music as instrument, not fake; uniqueness harder with generative AI.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，提出 AI 生成音乐应视为乐器而非伪造，生成式 AI 让真正独特变得更难。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; functional orgs work with high trust.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，强调长期任职建立信任与效率，高信任下职能组织可行。

gustav.en: Strategy 'time well spent' prioritizing well-being over engagement; contrarian anti-engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，战略为“时间花得值”，优先用户福祉而非参与度，反参与度决策。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; AI to empower not addict.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言控制服务，AI 应赋予用户控制而非致瘾。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和单一大型模型并不明显；将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信念的飞跃。

murati.en: Deploying AI in real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be public.
murati.zh: 在现实世界中部署 AI 对于学习和对齐至关重要；安全工作必须公开进行。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流式。

murati.en: Most advanced AI systems should be tools for thought, expanding what we think about.
murati.zh: 最先进的 AI 系统应成为思维工具，扩展我们的思考范围。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values as AI advances.
murati.zh: 随着 AI 的发展，让人类参与其中对于对齐意图和价值观至关重要。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique human activities, not benchmark scores; private evals are key IP for enterprises.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于赋能独特的人类活动，而非基准分数；私有评估是企业关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agentic systems will maximize returns for generalists, not specialists.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体式系统将最大化通才而非专才的回报。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业必须构建自己的爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; CEOs must understand token capital, not delegate AI.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；CEO 必须理解代币资本，而非将 AI 委托他人。

satya.en: Sovereign AI achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过赋能企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 或可复利增长 10%。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，观点深化：形式验证不仅是消除错误，更是扩展才华，能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，强调仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式方法必不可少。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，指出自动形式化比证明更难，正确形式化无解命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，认为即使超级 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍至关重要。

mensch.en: Data quality is critical for pre-training; scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla—train on more tokens, not just bigger models.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量对预训练至关重要；缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正——应训练更多 token，而非仅增大模型。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x over three years; scaling compute is not the only path—data quality and algorithms matter.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为算法效率三年可提升百倍；算力扩张并非唯一路径，数据质量与算法同样关键。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and open-source to empower enterprises; governments should embrace AI as opportunity, not fear.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张 AI 应去中心化、开源以赋能企业；政府应将 AI 视为机遇而非风险。

mensch.en: Pre-training hits saturation; differentiation shifts to domain-specific fine-tuning and vertical applications, not AGI.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，认为预训练趋于饱和；差异化转向领域微调和垂直应用，而非 AGI。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy in AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，强调欧洲需在 AI 基础设施上实现战略自主；企业采用瓶颈在于组织变革，而非模型智能。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future is local, personalized, and safe via sandboxing; skills enable automation, but shared tools remain vital.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 的未来在于本地化、个性化，并通过沙箱保障安全；技能（Skills）实现自动化，但共享工具仍很重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's main value is handling tedious tasks; the key gap is people's mindset, not capability.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：AI 的主要价值在于处理繁琐任务；关键差距在于人们的观念，而非能力。

felixrieseberg.en: Use different models for different tasks: Sonnet for well-scoped, Opus for open-ended; kids excel because they ask freely.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：针对不同任务选用不同模型：Sonnet 用于范围明确的任务，Opus 用于开放式任务；孩子因敢问而表现出色。

felixrieseberg.en: Interact with AI asynchronously, judge by impact, and debug workflows collaboratively with Claude.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：与 AI 异步交互，以最终效果评判，并与 Claude 协作调试工作流。

felixrieseberg.en: From emphasizing local tools and safety to focusing on human-AI collaboration and mindset shifts.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月至 5 月：从强调本地工具与安全，转向关注人机协作与思维转变。

kaiser.en: AI progress is exponential, not slowing; pre-training scaling still works but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展是指数级的，并未放缓；预训练的缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练改进（如强化学习、合成数据）驱动了近期大部分进展；经济压力使焦点转向更小模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data and have jagged generalization.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我认为推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据，且泛化能力参差不齐。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off, but big labs may struggle with future pivots.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢的赌注并取得成功，但大实验室未来可能难以应对类似转向。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential AI risk; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我更关注系统入侵等近期风险，而非存在性 AI 风险；开源模型因主权原因将持续存在。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size is the key lever for latency-cost tradeoff.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is due to memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce data movement by local weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本；脉动阵列通过本地权重复用减少数据移动。

reinerpope.en: Quadratic scaling with bit width makes low precision far more efficient; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 位宽二次方缩放使低精度效率远超预期；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并非根本不同。

jonyive.en: Design driven by curiosity and purpose, not profit; virtual tools can't replace in-person creative collaboration.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调设计应由好奇心和使命感驱动，而非利润；虚拟工具无法替代面对面创意协作的价值。

jonyive.en: Simplicity must retain soul and joy; care in creation expresses gratitude; teams need trust to protect fragile ideas.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化了简约理念，认为真正的简约需保留灵魂与乐趣；用心创造是表达感恩；团队需信任以呵护脆弱创意。

jonyive.en: Innovation is essential to design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes; EV constraints enable new possibilities.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他重申创新是设计之本，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；电动化约束反而开启新设计可能。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience matters; mimicking combustion sounds is fake; physical controls beat touchscreens in cars.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他坚持用户体验的真实性，反对模拟燃油车声浪；在汽车中主张物理按键优于触屏，延续对人性化设计的坚持。

jonyive.en: Design must serve human values, balance beauty and function, and avoid patronizing users with genuine care.
jonyive.zh: 贯穿始终，他坚信设计应服务于人类价值，平衡美感与功能，并以真诚关怀避免居高临下地对待用户。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) remains core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, demanding algorithmic innovation.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他强调两阶段训练（预训练模仿+后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的共同核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减，需要算法创新。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis for reasoning, and long context windows enable working memory but can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他认为推理时算力（思考）是提升推理能力的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，长上下文窗口提供工作记忆但信息过多会干扰模型。

oriol.en: Giving models tools (search, code, browser) enables agentic behavior beyond static weights; superintelligence may first emerge in narrow domains like science.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他提出赋予模型工具（搜索、代码、浏览器）可实现超越静态权重的智能体式行为；超级智能可能先在科学等窄领域出现。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video/images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他认为联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL remain a green field with huge potential; memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他强调后训练和强化学习仍是潜力巨大的蓝海；智能体的记忆将通过非参数文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and craft, not rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年：传统设计流程已过时，设计师应信任直觉与技艺，而非僵化步骤。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build and ship fast, with vision 3-6 months out.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年：设计流程已死，设计师需快速构建与交付，愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads, not just T-shaped.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年：设计师应成为块状通才或“破解版新毕业生”，而非仅 T 型人才。

jennywen.en: AI improves taste but humans decide what matters; speed is not an improvement argument.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年：AI 提升品味但人类决定何者重要；速度本身不是改进理由。

jennywen.en: Designers' unique value is judgment, ambiguity tolerance, and user-centeredness.
jennywen.zh: 始终：设计师的独特价值在于判断力、容忍模糊性及以用户为中心。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as top fine-tuning method; openness crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is system-level, not just model artifact.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍是最流行的微调方法，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要；安全是系统级属性，而非仅模型产物。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance, DPO and RL add last 10% but crucial for reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年：后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT 贡献 90%性能，DPO 和 RL 补充最后 10%，但对推理至关重要。

lambert.en: RLVR is key post-training breakthrough; overoptimization risk; open models need better tool-use training; hybrid reasoning may be temporary.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 是后训练关键突破，存在过度优化风险；开放模型需加强工具使用训练；混合推理模型可能是暂时的。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：预训练缩放定律仍有效，但易得收益已尽；增长转向后训练和推理扩展；开放模型落后 6-9 个月。

lambert.en: Open models drive next decade of AI research; Chinese labs excel in engineering, not paradigm invention; compute constraints widen US-China gap.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：开放模型驱动未来十年 AI 研究；中国实验室擅长工程执行而非范式创新；算力限制扩大中美差距。

karpathy.en: Transformers are differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是可微计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but needs entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoids benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端路线正确；人形机器人受益于汽车迁移学习。

karpathy.en: LLMs are like OSes; Software 3.0 is prompting; agents need a decade, keep them on a leash with human oversight.
karpathy.zh: LLM 如同操作系统；软件 3.0 即提示工程；智能体需十年发展，应保持人类监督的约束。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; RL is weak, synthetic data collapses; cognitive core may be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵而非动物；强化学习薄弱，合成数据导致模型崩溃；认知核心可能极小。

karpathy.en: I haven't coded since December; agents do all; focus shifts to directing agents and agent-first infrastructure.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我不再写代码，全部交给智能体；重点转向指挥智能体与智能体优先的基础设施。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting, enabling better generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年：强调超越训练分布的泛化能力是关键；好奇心驱动的探索通过防止过拟合来提升泛化。

pathak.en: From curiosity-driven exploration to data-driven pretraining: robotics needs diverse data sources, not just video.
pathak.zh: 2020 至 2026 年：从好奇心探索转向数据驱动的预训练，认为机器人需要多样数据源，而非仅视频。

pathak.en: A general-purpose robot brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot across form factors and tasks.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：提出通用机器人大脑，类似语言领域的 ChatGPT，可驱动不同形态和任务的机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary challenge in robotics; it cannot be scaled like software and requires rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：部署是机器人主要挑战，无法像软件一样扩展，需严格测试。

pathak.en: Scaling data and compute is essential, but robotics requires real-world and simulation data, not just internet data.
pathak.zh: 始终：强调数据与算力扩展的重要性，但机器人需要真实世界与仿真数据，而非仅互联网数据。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署有助于在现实应用中学习和缓解风险（2025）。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现（2026）。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool, providing interpretability.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键对齐工具，提供可解释性（2026）。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式（2026）。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; hybrid systems get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他强调端到端深度学习优于手工编码的堆栈，混合系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他认为世界模型带来推理和涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯前试探性前行。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他指出纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks, eliminating traffic lights.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他设想 AV 3.0 通过网状网络将智能移至车外，从而取消红绿灯。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他宣称无需事先训练数据即可在 500 多个城市实现零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他认为中短期内消费级车辆规模将超过 Robotaxi。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他总结基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键，这是后期学到的教训。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年或更久；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluations with sophisticated, creative evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且可被钻空子；真正的进展需要由老练且富有创造力的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to differentiated AIs; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室在目标函数上分化，导致 AI 差异化；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以契合其独特理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI tools require human judgment; doctors may underperform AI alone due to anchoring and sycophancy, so safety must prioritize omission risks.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 工具需要人类判断；医生可能因锚定和谄媚而表现不如单独使用 AI，因此安全必须优先考虑遗漏风险。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily. Chat is like MS-DOS; future interface will evolve beyond chat.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代、每日发布。聊天界面如同 MS-DOS，未来界面将超越聊天。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
