turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型需严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型在无缝产品化后具有变革性。

turley.en: Curiosity is the most important skill in AI era; writing remains valuable as it forces clear thinking.
turley.zh: 好奇心是 AI 时代最重要的技能；写作仍然有价值，因为它促使清晰思考。

carlpei.en: Building a brand unites teams on purpose; startups should start simple to survive and prove themselves.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，裴宇认为品牌建设应以更高使命凝聚团队，创业公司应从简单产品起步以生存并证明自己。

carlpei.en: Smartphone future lies in generative UI and proactive agents; hardware is tough, so evolve beyond it.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年，他提出手机的未来在于生成式界面与主动式智能体，硬件艰难，需超越硬件。

carlpei.en: AI models commoditize; focus on applied AI for consumers, using context and trust, not hype.
carlpei.zh: 同年，他认为 AI 模型将商品化，应聚焦面向消费者的应用 AI，利用上下文与信任，而非炒作。

carlpei.en: Design differentiates mature categories; AI is an ingredient for utility, not a marketing buzzword.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他强调设计是成熟品类中的差异化关键，AI 只是提升体验的要素，而非营销噱头。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interfaces could, and apps will vanish.
carlpei.zh: 同年，他断言手机不会被眼镜取代，除非脑机接口出现；应用将消失，需开放 API。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为 AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题而非窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations, paired with truth detectors, can enable creative discovery.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可激发创造性发现。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's Move 37 showed AI can surpass human knowledge, a key transition point.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AlphaGo 的第 37 手证明 AI 能超越人类知识，是重要转折点。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为基于强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 他始终认为，可解释性对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges; no solutions yet, requiring open collaboration.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，他持续强调 AI 安全与负责任部署是最大挑战，且尚无解决方案，需要开放合作。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy issues in AI; local language models can revolutionize education and research.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他指出非洲在 AI 上能跳跃式发展，本地语言模型可革新教育，并鼓励非洲研究者敢于申请顶尖机构。

nando.en: Human skills like communication are as important as coding; diversity and inclusion are essential for beneficial AI.
nando.zh: 他始终认为沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要，多样性和包容性是构建有益 AI 的基础。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，他坚持根本性创新可来自任何地方，研究需拥抱失败并简化问题。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack real-world experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，认为具身对 AI 落地和减少幻觉至关重要，LLM 因缺乏真实体验而产生幻觉。

jimfan.en: Data bottleneck in robotics: real-world data scarce; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，持续强调机器人数据瓶颈，并转向合成数据与仿真作为扩展学习的关键。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test (robot cleaning messy house) is grand challenge; programmable factories and self-driving labs are near-term applications.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，提出物理图灵测试作为具身智能的终极挑战，并看好可编程工厂和自动驾驶湿实验室等近期应用。

jimfan.en: Robot foundation models via simple end-to-end learning from diverse data; GPT-3 moment for robotics in ~5 years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，主张用简单端到端模型融合多源数据构建机器人基础模型，并预测机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约五年后到来。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning for low-level control, LLMs for high-level planning; simulation enables scalable embodied training.
jimfan.zh: 始终认为强化学习适合底层控制，LLM 负责高层规划，仿真支撑大规模具身训练。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence and solving onboarding.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能提升智能并解决上手问题。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is a key breakthrough, enabling expert-level performance and new capabilities.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，能实现专家级表现并习得新能力。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL is likely sufficient for AGI; coding is the leading indicator and will accelerate AI research.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI；编程是领先指标，将加速 AI 研究。

sholto.en: Agentic coherence and reliability over time horizons matter more than raw capability; future work involves managing AI agent teams.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我转向强调智能体在时间跨度上的连贯性与可靠性，而非单纯能力；未来工作将是管理 AI 智能体团队。

sholto.en: Compute is the bottleneck; capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; world models aren't critical for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为算力是瓶颈；能力过剩意味着工具与编排更重要；世界模型并非 AGI 关键路径。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题；通过更优的数据和算法，较小模型也能媲美大模型。

yejin.en: Next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; post-training and RLHF are crucial but need open alternatives.
yejin.zh: 2023 至 2025 年间，我强调下一个词预测与人类学习方式不符，后训练和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）至关重要，但需开放替代方案。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; AI must go beyond human knowledge, using RL and synthetic data for discovery.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出数据是根本瓶颈，AI 需超越人类知识，借助强化学习和合成数据推动科学发现。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning; diverse post-training data prevents homogeneity.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张在预训练阶段引入强化学习以增强推理，并强调后训练数据的多样性以避免同质化。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse values; small models with quality data can democratize AI.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我倡导多元对齐以尊重不同价值观，并认为高质量数据驱动的小模型能推动 AI 民主化。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加快交付；优先追求速度和熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy evolves from recruiting and differentiation to a dynamic platform for expression and talent magnet.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，品牌策略从招聘与差异化，深化为动态表达平台和吸引人才的关键。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning, and hire diverse archetypes.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人需阐明其制胜作用，并招聘多元人才类型。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness trump perfection; organic feedback and gut decisions beat structured crits and data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，坚持速度与决断优于完美；有机反馈和直觉决策胜过结构化评审与数据。

henrymodisett.en: Give designers ownership and autonomy; adapt process to problem, not universal templates.
henrymodisett.zh: 始终主张赋予设计师自主权，流程应因问题而异，而非套用统一模板。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; AI is a creative partner for rapid experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈，通过引导工程师和聚焦问题来协作；AI 是创意伙伴，支持快速试错。

nadchishtie.en: Future design tools are interoperable with code as source of truth; legacy layers panel is outdated; AI enables genuine progress.
nadchishtie.zh: 未来设计工具应互操作，以代码为源；传统图层面板已过时；AI 带来真正的进步。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; small cross-functional teams beat 8-10 person squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补位的通才最有价值；小而美的跨职能团队优于 8-10 人大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects and paid tests reveal real skill.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应展示工艺与意图，而非流程；副项目和付费测试更能体现真实能力。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; ignoring it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；忽视它如同早期忽视互联网。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research; alignment and robustness are key; PhD path recommended.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全需要实证研究，对齐和鲁棒性是关键，建议通过博士路径进入该领域。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability; alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient; external oversight needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，指出 OpenAI 安全文化退化，后训练不足以解决对齐问题，需要外部监管。

truell.en: Initially, natural language won't be primary for coding; examples and direct manipulation are better. Scaling laws predict progress, but local models aren't the future.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我认为自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例和直接操作更好；缩放定律预示进展，但本地模型不是未来。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central. Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling.
truell.zh: 2024 年，智能体有前景但尚不实用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练缩放。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification, humans in driver's seat. Taste and logic design become more valuable than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年，编程从代码转向意图描述，人类主导；品味和逻辑设计比细心更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost. Every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年，定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其速度和成本；Cursor 的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: AI shift more consequential than internet, decades to unfold. Incumbents may struggle; senior engineers underrate AI, juniors over-rely.
truell.zh: 2025 年，AI 变革比互联网影响更大，需数十年展开；现有巨头可能挣扎，资深工程师低估 AI，初级工程师过度依赖。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields smarter AI, but internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型是 AI 完备的；通过算力和数据扩展能让 AI 更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇；模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他预测未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口；模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）可实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial for AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习对 AGI 至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; economic impact far beyond trillion-dollar products. Coding is underhyped; it enables AI self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他坚持 AGI 被低估，经济影响远超万亿美元产品；编码也被低估，它使 AI 自我加速成为可能。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hardware and software advances; self-play and imitation learning are strong signals; RL lacks hierarchical reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，认为机器人需要软硬件双重突破，自我对弈和模仿学习是强学习信号，强化学习缺乏分层推理。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL boosts sample efficiency; avoid hard-coding priors; aim for 99.9% reliability in real-world robotics.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，主张无监督学习结合强化学习提升样本效率，避免硬编码先验知识，并以 99.9%可靠性作为现实机器人目标。

abbeel.en: Consistently values learning from data over hand-coded rules, and sees RL as core for embodied intelligence.
abbeel.zh: 始终重视从数据中学习而非手工规则，视强化学习为具身智能的核心。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks, hinting at general intelligence beyond language.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，指出预训练语言模型可迁移推理到非语言任务，暗示超越语言的通用智能。

abbeel.en: Moved from simulation-focused RL to real-world deployment, emphasizing reliability and unsupervised learning for practicality.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 年侧重仿真强化学习，到 2021 年转向现实部署，强调可靠性与无监督学习的实用性。
